newsitem.title: USA: Collaborative Clinical to buy U-Gene Research.
newsitem.headline: Collaborative Clinical to buy U-Gene Research.

text.p: Collaborative Clinical Research Inc said it signed a letter of intent to acquire U-Gene Research BV in exchange for about 1.75 million newly issued common shares of Collaborative Clinical Research Inc.
It said the transaction will be treated as a pooling of interests for accounting purposes and is expected to be accretive.
The companies expect to sign a definitive agreement in February and to close this transaction in March or April, Collaborative said.

In addition to negotiation of the definitive agreement, the transaction is also subject to other customary conditions, including the approval of the board of both companies and of the shareholders of Collaborative.
